<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (node*)>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'expanded_value'>">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY ent_ref "&ent; and text">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY banner SYSTEM "banner.png" NDATA png>
  <?target-pi data="processing instruction value"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub" sub:id="123">
  <!-- Top-level comment spanning multiple namespaces and entities -->
  <?custom-pi test="active"?>
  <node sub:name="test">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing unparsed markup <node>&ent_ref;</node> &banner;
    ]]>
  </node>
  <sub:node>&ent_ref;</sub:node>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local_dtd "<!ENTITY dynamic 'Injected Parameter Value'>">
  %local_dtd;
  <!ENTITY combined "&dynamic; plus text">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment detailing catalog initialization -->
  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <?catalog-action execute="refresh"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload with entity reference &combined; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&combined;</item>
</catalog>
```

<!DOCTYPE enterprise [
  <!ELEMENT enterprise (department*)>
  <!ELEMENT department (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent_a "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY ent_b "&ent_a; Beta">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ELEMENT department (#PCDATA)>">
  %pe;
  <?xml-debug log-level="verbose"?>
]>
<enterprise xmlns="http://enterprise.org/ns" xmlns:hr="http://enterprise.org/ns/hr">
  <!-- Begin enterprise root structure -->
  <?hr:audit status="pending"?>
  <hr:department>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing legacy entities: &ent_b;
    ]]>
  </hr:department>
  <department>&ent_b;</department>
</enterprise>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY core "CoreData">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "external.txt">
  <!ENTITY % markup "<!ATTLIST record id ID #IMPLIED>">
  %markup;
  <?archive-manager mode="auto"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/schema/meta">
  <!-- Multi-namespace archive root with comments and instructions -->
  <?meta:control action="verify"?>
  <record id="rec1">
    <![CDATA[
      Embedded CDATA block with entity expansion check: &core; &ext;
    ]]>
  </record>
  <meta:record id="rec2">&core;</meta:record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE registry [
  <!ELEMENT registry (entry*)>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e_ref "RegistryReference">
  <!ENTITY % ext_pe "<!ENTITY e_pe_ref 'ParameterValue'>">
  %ext_pe;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <?registry-setup mode="strict"?>
]>
<registry xmlns="http://registry.org/ns" xmlns:cfg="http://registry.org/ns/config">
  <!-- Registry configuration comment block -->
  <?cfg:load source="init.cfg"?>
  <entry cfg:priority="high">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block holding binary reference: &doc; and text &e_ref; &e_pe_ref;
    ]]>
  </entry>
  <cfg:entry>&e_ref;</cfg:entry>
</registry>
```
